notes.title: Gruniożerca Trilogy Now Available for Wishlisting!
notes.content:
Hello, Veterans of the 8-Bit Era!
We are pleased to announce that Gruniożerca Trilogy - a remastered collection of three independently developed retro puzzle games - is now available for wishlisting on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45626289/5b2fb7ab3f61410ffbfd4a40e40c1ac60ccef051.png
This special release is the result of a close collaboration between Take IT Studio! and ARHN.EU, created to celebrate the 15th anniversary of the ARHN.EU platform. As part of this project, we have completely rebuilt all three titles from the ground up, faithfully preserving their original charm while bringing them to modern platforms with enhanced performance and stability.

Whether you’re discovering the adventures of Grunio for the first time or returning as a long-time fan, this collection offers a thoughtfully preserved journey through the golden era of 8-bit puzzle design.

By adding Gruniożerca Trilogy to your wishlist, you will:
📅 Receive timely notifications about the game’s release.
📢 Support the visibility of the project within the Steam community.

About the Trilogy:
Gruniożerca – The original title that introduced players to Grunio’s unique, puzzle-based world.
Gruniożerca 2 – A sequel that expands on the original with new challenges and gameplay scenarios.
Gruniożerca 3: The Great Cavy Clean-Up! – Introducing entirely new mechanics and inventive, humorous situations.

All titles have been faithfully adapted for modern platforms by Take IT Studio!, ensuring smooth performance while preserving the distinctive visual and audio style of the originals.

Key Features:
🕹️ Authentic 8-bit inspired visuals and soundtrack.
🕹️ Three unique gameplay experiences within one collection.
🕹️ Carefully balanced retro aesthetics with modern usability.
🕹️ A memorable protagonist and a world full of character.

We invite you to add Gruniożerca Trilogy to your Steam wishlist and stay informed about upcoming announcements and the official release date.

Thank you for your support, and we look forward to sharing more details with you soon!
